meta.name: bids
meta.description: Use this skill when working with Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) datasets: organizing neuroscience and biomedical data (MRI, EEG, MEG, iEEG, PET, microscopy, NIRS, motion capture, EMG, MR spectroscopy, behavioral), querying BIDS layouts, validating compliance, converting DICOM to BIDS, writing metadata sidecars, or creating BIDS derivatives.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将脑影像数据整理为 BIDS 标准格式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在处理神经科学影像数据并需要 BIDS 合规化
copy.tagline_en: Organize neuroscience imaging data into BIDS standard
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are processing neuroscience imaging data and need BIDS compliance

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能按 BIDS 标准帮你整理和查询脑影像数据集:建目录结构与 dataset_description.json、按受试者/任务找文件、写 JSON 元数据、校验合规、把 DICOM 转成 BIDS。
howto.when: 当你提到 BIDS 或脑影像数据(如 MRI、EEG)等关键词,或要求整理数据、校验合规、转换 DICOM 时触发。

say.text: 帮我查这个数据集里 sub-01 的 task-nback bold 文件路径
say.note: 用 PyBIDS 索引并返回文件路径

say.text: 校验 /data/bids 这个数据集是否符合 BIDS 规范
say.note: 运行 bids-validator 并报告问题

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can organize and query brain-imaging datasets to the BIDS standard: build directory structures and dataset_description.json, find files by subject or task, write JSON sidecars, check compliance, and convert DICOM to BIDS.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention BIDS or brain data such as MRI and EEG, or ask to organize a dataset, validate compliance, convert DICOM, or query a BIDS layout.

say_en.text: Convert the DICOM in /data/raw to a BIDS dataset using HeuDiConv
say_en.note: Creates BIDS folders and sidecar files

say_en.text: Find the task-nback bold file path for sub-01 in this dataset
say_en.note: Indexes with PyBIDS and returns the path

say_en.text: Validate whether /data/bids follows the BIDS specification
